# VEYRS dependency lock — the exact set a production node runs.
#
# Regenerate:  ./scripts/freeze-deps.sh   (needs network: it fetches the hashes)
# Install:     venv/bin/pip install --require-hashes -r requirements.txt
# Audit:       scripts/osv-check.py       SBOM: scripts/sbom.sh
#
# Direct dependencies and the reasoning behind them live in pyproject.toml.
# This file is the FULL resolved graph, transitive packages included, so a new
# app node (a3, a disaster-recovery rebuild, a laptop) gets byte-identical
# software instead of whatever PyPI resolves to that morning. Every pin carries
# the sha256 of each published file of that version (--require-hashes).
#
# Python 3.11.2
